wf.extract.quote: Extract slices grounded spans from the source document; it does not retrieve and it does not summarize.

wf.general.quote: General summarizes when no specialized operator matches the input class; summarize is its home class.

wf.scout.quote: Scout indexes the corpus and fans out retrieval; it is the search-class candidate, not a general synthesizer.

wf.transform.quote: Transform rewrites a payload into a typed target schema; it is the transform-class candidate.
